known.title: Configure a shadow database before requiring the Prisma drift check

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 4 (floor: migration)
Raise: Functional.
Case: normal use - checking a raw-SQL migration in a newly initialized Prisma app.
The prescribed `--from-migrations` command requires a configured shadow database, but the shipped `src/forge/templates/starter/prisma.config.ts:8` configures only `datasource.url`. Consequently, this command fails before comparing schemas, even when they match. [Prisma documents this prerequisite](https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/v7/prisma-migrate/understanding-prisma-migrate/shadow-database). Document creation and configuration of a separate shadow database before this command, including in both synced skill copies.
